thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 12/21-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 126-day SMA regime filter on CSCO, LRCX, CRM, AMAT, VUG, with a 8% stop, a 34% target and a 154-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(126) and ema(12) crosses_above ema(21)
